bracu_official.title: BRAC University Biotechnology students gain industry exposure through BRAC-Aarong Dairy Visit
bracu_official.summary: Biotechnology students from BRAC University gained valuable industry exposure during a visit to BRAC-Aarong Dairy. This visit provided practical insight into the operations of a leading dairy company.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University holds workshop on BAC Accreditation readiness
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University conducted a workshop focused on preparing for BAC Accreditation. The event aimed to ensure the university's readiness for the upcoming accreditation process.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University is proud to announce the advisory council and fellows of the new Centre of Energy and Logistics (CEL)
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University announced the formation of the advisory council and fellows for its newly established Centre of Energy and Logistics (CEL). This initiative marks a significant step in the center's development.
